newsitem.title: UK: Verity jumps on strong results, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Verity jumps on strong results, outlook.

text.p: Shares in Verity Group surged on Monday to their highest levels since May 1991 after the company last Friday reported a strong set of annual results and expressed confidence that growth will continue, traders said.
At 0917 GMT, the shares were up 5-1/4p, or 22.5 percent, to 28-1/2p on heavy volume of 13.9 million shares.
Verity shares, topping the most active list this morning, traded as high as 30p.
On Friday, the electronics audio equipment maker said its pre-tax profits rose 31 percent to 2.6 million stg in the year ended June 30.
In a statement, the company said its new loudspeaker technology and the development of new technologies promised to help Verity sustain a rapid pace of growth.
